notes: Trust-the-screenshot corrections: (1) Raw profile's top color rgb(247,248,248) at count 2696 is the FOREGROUND text/border, not the background — it dominates by element count, not by area. Pixel-sampling the canvas gives rgb(8,9,10)=#08090a, the true dark bg; surfaces are near-black rgb(15,16,17)/rgb(8,9,10). Roles relabeled accordingly. (2) The single registered fontFamily is Berkeley Mono (used for code/labels, 311 nodes); the body/display face is the system sans (Inter-class) that the profile didn't tag — confirmed by the geometric, tightly-tracked headline shapes. (3) Weights are the real Inter optical values 400/510/590 (not 500/600/700) — kept verbatim since they are intentional. (4) Two saturated brand colors (chartreuse #e4f222, blue wash #d3e6ff) appear ONCE each, only on testimonial cards; kept as 'spotlight' roles, not core accent. The functional accent is the muted periwinkle #8fa6ff. (5) Dropped one-off radii (400px, 1px, 22px) and the rgba(0,255,5,..)/rgba(255,0,0,..) values which are dev/debug highlight artifacts, not design colors. (6) 13.3333px rounded to 13px; px scale converted to rem at 16px root. (7) MOTION re-captured 2026-06-24 with the motion+craft pipeline; corroborated against frames s00-s10 (corpus/production/screenshots/linear-app/frames/), the computed-style profile, and raw/linear-app.json `.motion`/`.craft`. The 82-keyframe count is inflated by a per-dot grid system (~58 grid-dot-* rules) — collapsed to one `ambient-dot-grid-loop` technique. Page is largely static at rest; only the dot-grid loop + marquees move continuously, the rest is in-view reveal / sticky / hover. Reduced-motion respected; ships resting state. Type scale widened to the captured set (10/12/13/14/16/20/24 UI + 32/48/64/72 display) and tracking documented as size-proportional (-0.022em display -> ~-0.011em UI), not a constant.
